preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.
The contract must have a native currency (BNB/ETH) balance greater than zero.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `withdraw()` function. This function is protected by an `onlyOwner` modifier and will transfer the entire native currency balance of the contract to the owner's address, allowing the owner to drain all accumulated BNB/ETH from the contract.
